notes.title: Turbo Sloths Major Update #2!!!
notes.content:
[b]💥Dear Friends, The big update #2 is here[/b]

[b]🎉 New features & capabilities: [/b]
Added the Korean localisation
Added the support for Vulkan
Rebalanced the career, as well as made necessary changes to the in-game economics
Added a new race at the very start of your career. 
Active Gas Acceleration has been given a boost
Added a setting that allows you to switch between special events (e.g. St. Valentine’s Day, Easter, Halloween)
Added a setting to disable popping up messages from fans
Added new special events (i.e. St. Valentine’s Day, Easter, Halloween)
Added a setting to toggle the display of volumetric clouds
Added a few extra graphics settings

[b]🔧Bugfixes & improvements: [/b]
Fixed an issue with certain sounds, which could not be turned off, or these were triggered improperly
Fixed a bug with Overheating: It did not accelerate the vehicle to the desired extent
Fixed a bug with replenishing ammunition upon killing the Turtle war bot
Destroying Turbojunks now slightly refills your ammunition
Fixed an issue that required an online status in Steam (Requirement has now been removed)
Changed a few default parameters for a smoother and a more comfortable start in the career
Improved weight values for certain objects
Improved collision for certain traps
Fixed a number of critical bugs
Fixed critical bugs in the ‘Split screen’ mode
Improved helper bot spawning for the ‘Split screen’ mode
Outside the Arena encounters, bots will no longer use rockets.

All of the above fixes and improvements have been made thanks to your comments and suggestions. Thank you very much for your interest and dedication to our game! We work hard to make it look and work better and smoother!

[b]🚀We wish you a highly enjoyable gaming experience!!!🚀[/b]

notes.title: Turbo Sloths + DLC Major Update!!!
notes.content:
[h1]A massive update is finally here![/h1]

We are thrilled to announce the release of the first substantial update for Turbo Sloths! We extend our heartfelt thanks to all who have provided feedback, as well as those eagerly awaiting this update. Your support has been instrumental in improving the game and making it even more entertaining! A big thank you to all - this release is a collective achievement.

[previewyoutube=BrpcnCrPWbU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The update includes the following:[/h2]

[h3]A significant graphical overhaul.[/h3]
All locations have undergone extensive enhancements. This has significantly improved both the game's visuals and performance. The update also optimises video memory consumption, benefiting players with less powerful GPUs.

[h3]New vehicles.[/h3]
We've added two new vehicles: a Pick-Up and a UFO, complete with corresponding parts for upgrades and customisation. Each new vehicle boasts unique abilities to diversify gameplay.

[h3]Improved handling.[/h3]
We've substantially improved handling, making it more responsive and beginner-friendly. We hope you'll appreciate it.

[h3]New 'Quick Race' modes.[/h3]
These new modes involve shooting targets on the go and battling bosses - minor additions, but highly entertaining.

[h3]Other minor improvements include:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fine-tuned bot behaviour.
[*] In-game tips (can be disabled in the settings menu).
[*] The option to select the IRIS ability in the Garage.
[*] Numerous bug fixes.
[*] Enhanced overall game stability and performance.
[/list]


[h2]We also want to express our gratitude to all the supporters who eagerly anticipated the promised DLC, which includes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new career stage, a whole new area with a boss, and 36 unique challenging races.
[*] A new arena to decimate war bots.
[*] A new weapon - the heavy machine gun.
[*] A new and final stage, packed with 8 ruthless decisive races to bring the Wasteland League and the story to a close.
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]A DEMO is now available for download so you can see what you, as racers, are truly capable of.[/h3]

Thank you very much for your attention! Special thanks to the fans who have been continuously following our progress on the project. We appreciate it immensely!

notes.title: Turbo Sloths goes live on December 8
notes.content:
Dear Friends, 
September 2020 marks the start of the whole development thing about the game. From the very first sketch and until this very moment, that the game is complete, we have put all of our best ideas, our heart and soul into the process to build a game world like no other out there in the industry. This our debut release, and we'll remember it for the rest of our days. The time is finally here to release it and move on to accomplish even more! For our team this is a big event, a red letter day, you name it, and we are eager to share the joy with you.
We are certain, that there are even more greater and cooler things to happen and experience in the future!
Join the ride on December, 8!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970760/292eb5df3e147e39d3342c46a9a02e5d8fc63491.png[/img]

And here are our special thanks to those, who contributed, gave us feedback, tested the game throughout the entire course of development, and guided us! If it hadn't been for you, ladies and gentlemen, we would've never seen this day to ever come!

Thank you very much for your continuous support!

notes.title: Turbo Sloths - DEMO 2.0
notes.content:
[h2]Hi, folks![/h2]
It’s been two years of hard work that we’ve put into our project, and we’re excited to announce the release of demo version 2.0
It can boast of a vast line-up of improvements: 
- Handling issues have been addressed and given proper treatment.
- More new tracks with obstacles.
- New weapons.
- Finally, there are Bosses roaming far and wide across Turia! 
- Story mode is now available.
- Camera now offers new view options to choose from.
- A Player will now occasionally be supported by helper drones when the need is dire.
- Environment and opponent’s vehicles are now destructible!
- War bots and much more for your amusement!
- Night mode.
And we can’t wait for you to try this new stuff out!

[h2]Cool music in the Game![/h2]
Apart from stuff already mentioned, you can now enjoy the ‘Radio’ packed with cool bands and their music to race to!

notes.title: Turbo Sloths - Roller View - Gameplay test
Nvidia RTX ON Trailer and Game Updates
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there, fellows! [/h2] 
We are happy to share a fantastic piece of news with you: The Turbosloths game video has been published on the official Nvidia channel, which is amazing, because the game supports the state-of-the-art RTX and DLSS technologies.

Watch the video here: [url=https://youtu.be/fNnenDGNcTI]Turbo Sloths RTX On. [/url]
[previewyoutube=fNnenDGNcTI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] 

[h2]And now, to the update![/h2] 

We have made a decent amount of improvements to the game itself, as well as gameplay: Locations now look way better thanks to more detail and number of destructible objects to interact with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970760/95dcc987420fcf1ee7a43e93323963907447becd.png[/img] 

Different Turbojunk bodies now have their unique abilities: 
1. Additional Turbine enables you to jump over on-track obstacles. 
2. Thanks to Slow Time you will be able to delicately resolve tricky situations which may arise during the race. 
3. A Plasma Shield turns you into a megatorpedo, actually an overkill for those, who oppose you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970760/9baccf95a2d364bf3c13b8da34d2a2e71329af35.png[/img]

The game now will throw Megabosses at you for you to beat down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970760/ef9a8970dd18a1ba8cf1c6f7535b014af4be35c2.png[/img] 

Tracks now feature assisting and adverse mechanics. Some of these mechanics are designed to aid you during the race, while others do what it takes to toast you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970760/dbd56b4d094b22a936326dbcbc2b1b3217aa3c57.png[/img] 

This latest update also features a great deal of minor improvements addressing the UI, storyline and gameplay. 

Dear Friends, thank you very much for your vivid interest in our project.
We will appreciate whatever kind and form of support you may show, as we are a small indie studio! You are always welcome to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/ruhtCSxNJr]Discord[/url] and put the game on your wishlists! Cheers and best of luck to all!

notes.title: Realise date & Updates.
Turbo Sloths gamedev update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! The time is here to share a piece of news about the development progress.
We have gone through many milestones developing our project.

What has been done?
1. We have built our own physical models for the in-game vehicles and made improvements to handling and on-track stability. 

2. Sloth character backgrounds and artworks have been created. Our team has chosen to make 2D character modesl in order to accelerate the process and make them stand out and be memorable. We intend to create 3D models for these characters. Time shall tell, what’s coming next, but now, we’d like you to meet Joe, the mechanic, and Sue, a hot-tempered young lady in the races. These two are dying to meet you as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970760/a01c1b5bc3989bfd918320151fe2baa28e08c0ee.png[/img]

3. As of now, three racing tracks and the tutorial have been designed from the ground up. ːsteamhappyː

4. We have launched a dedicated Discord channel (https://discord.gg/KCs5Dg5X) and a Twitter account (https://twitter.com/Tsloths). You’re welcome to join our new-born community, where you may get a chance to win a game key, provided that you’re actively engaged in conversation and discussion.

What are we currently engaged in?
We are now polishing racing modes, statistics, etc.

Apart from that, we are also designing the garage and vehicle customization capability.

The work on bots for the races has kicked in. Thanks to the new fellow in our team, the entire process should now run even better.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970760/06cb3cae035b1e0e6349269c36ebb921412ec856.png[/img]

Thank you all for reading and stay in touch! ːsteamthumbsupː
